2. Drug Information
Drug Name: mRNA-1273 (Spikevax)
Indication: Prevention of COVID-19
Dose: 100 mcg / 0.5 mL
Route: Intramuscular
Dose Number: Dose 1
Date of Administration: 26 April 2025
3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 50-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 22 June 2025. Approximately 9 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Anaphylaxis. The patient sought medical attention and was hospitalized for observation. The outcome was recovered with sequelae. The reporter cannot exclude a relationship with mRNA-1273 vaccination.
